request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, badges, book spines and walls. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Keep the person, both hands and everything the sentence depends on inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.

Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.

Image 1 shows Diego. Keep his face, dark curly hair with a little grey, skin tone and build exactly. Create a new photograph of Diego in a bright cafe, with plants and a wooden counter softly out of focus behind him. He faces the camera from the waist up and smiles warmly. His short, full dark beard with a little grey at the chin is neatly trimmed and clearly covers his cheeks, chin and upper lip: the beard is the most obvious thing about his face. He wears his dark navy blazer over a burgundy button shirt, with no badge, and holds nothing.
